niche.title: Back Pain Shooting Down Your Leg? Quick Sciatica Quiz #Shorts
niche.description:
Pain that shoots from the lower back down one leg is often sciatica. It usually happens when a bulging disc or narrowing in the spine presses on the sciatic nerve.
Most people improve within a few weeks with gentle activity, good posture and guided exercises.
See a doctor if: your leg turns weak, the groin area goes numb, passing urine or stools becomes difficult, or the pain lasts more than a few weeks.
From ortho history: in 1741 Nicolas Andry coined “orthopaedics”. His crooked tree tied to a straight stake still reminds us that good support and posture help the back.
